Install: ci-doctor matchers add official/pnpm

matchers/js/pnpm/matcher.yaml

id: pnpm
role: tool
classification: [js, deps]
description: pnpm's `ERR_PNPM_*` codes - the resolver or lockfile refusing, which is the cause itself.
pattern: ERR_PNPM_\w+
before: 1
after: 10
